name: scrapyard-manager
description: Scrapyard cars & parts manager — Angular + NestJS + Neon Postgres

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix apps/api --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix apps/web --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run start
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && node scripts/prepare-deploy.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:api && cd apps/web && npx ng build --configuration development --no-progress
